description: This Java class, LiveCommandAnswerFactory, is a factory for creating immutable instances of LiveCommandAnswer, which encapsulate command responses and events within the Eclipse Ditto signals framework.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerFactory
classes.description: A final utility factory class that provides static methods to create instances of LiveCommandAnswer based on command responses and events.

methods.name: newLiveCommandAnswer
methods.description: Creates a new immutable LiveCommandAnswer instance with a provided CommandResponse.

methods.name: newLiveCommandAnswer
methods.description: Creates a new immutable LiveCommandAnswer instance with a provided Event.

methods.name: newLiveCommandAnswer
methods.description: Creates a new immutable LiveCommandAnswer instance with both a CommandResponse and an Event.
